import build123d as bd, numpy as np
# Dimensions (mm), converted to metres at export
BORE_D, SHAFT_D, L = 40.1, 40.0, 60.0
KW_W, KW_D = 12.0, 5.0   # keyway width/depth
S = 0.001                # mm -> m scale

bore = bd.Cylinder(BORE_D/2, L, align=bd.Align.MIN)          # sealed bore, z in [0, L]
shaft = bd.Cylinder(SHAFT_D/2, L, align=bd.Align.MIN)
# keyway cut: box spanning full length, 12 wide, 5 deep into shaft
kw = bd.Box(KW_W, 2*KW_D, L, align=(bd.Align.CENTER, bd.Align.MIN, bd.Align.MIN))
kw = kw.located(bd.Pos(0, SHAFT_D/2 - 2*KW_D + 0.1, 0).location)  # rough slot into shaft top
fluid = bore - shaft - kw
print("volume (mm^3):", fluid.volume, " faces:", len(fluid.faces()))
m = np.array(sorted([(f.area, bd.Face(f).center().to_tuple(), getattr(f,'label','?')) for f in fluid.faces()], key=lambda t: t[1][2]))
for f in fluid.faces():
    c = f.center().to_tuple()
    print(round(f.area,2), [round(v,3) for v in c])
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import pyvista as pv
tri = fluid.tessellate(0.05)
pl = pv.Plotter(off_screen=True)
pl.add_mesh(pv.PolyData(np.array(tri[0]), np.concatenate((np.full((len(tri[1]),1),3), tri[1]))), color='tan', opacity=0.5)
pl.add_text("fluid", position='upper_left')
pl.show(screenshot='w')
plt.imshow(pv.get_image("w")); plt.axis('off'); plt.show()
